Chinese action-RPG painterly energy aesthetic: deep crimson underside, saturated vermilion body, amber-gold broken edges, a thin pale gold leading vein, elegantly split barbs and negative spaces. Feather fully contained inside square canvas with generous transparent padding, occupies central70%. This will be duplicated and articulated in-engine to form opening phoenix wings, and noise-eroded with a custom shader. Original asset inspired by fantasy RPG shape language, not a screenshot.
